environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode, (3) a custom rule with ByteMatchStatement targeting query string values for the patterns UNION, union, SELECT, select, OR 1, or 1, --, with SearchString positional constraint CONTAINS and TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE, action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. ECS task role has no network egress policy restricting outbound (the container can reach the internet). The ALB target group health check hits /health. CloudWatch logging is enabled for WAF but plays no blocking role.

rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
rules.note: SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING is set to COUNT (not BLOCK)

config.network: VPC with NAT gateway, no egress restriction
